cumleler: Can earphones show a hearing loss that is not really there?
Pressure from supra-aural, or on-ear, earphones can collapse the ear canal.
It is more common in older adults, as cartilage becomes less elastic.
A collapsed canal falsely worsens thresholds at high frequencies.
A false air-bone gap can then appear on the audiogram.
The most effective way to prevent collapse is using insert earphones.
